text: Decision for the export API: every export request, including large exports, must run synchronously and return the completed download. Do not return a job identifier or queue the export. This applies to the upcoming release.

In the export benchmark I observed that 50,000-row exports take 42 seconds, while the gateway terminates requests after 30 seconds. Small 100-row exports finish in 0.2 seconds. These measurements are from the release configuration.

I have decided that the upcoming release must queue every export request and immediately return a job identifier. The export endpoint will never wait for the completed download. This conflicts with the synchronous requirement; I need the user to confirm whether to change that requirement.
